beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The Thousand-Handed Devil asks who answers when every participant followed the process.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A harmful outcome can emerge from individually defensible decisions with no single directing villain.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book examines complexity that transfers understanding and appeal costs onto affected people.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its response is mature simplicity, with visible responsibilities and real powers of interruption.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers learn to trace connected duties without replacing difficult systems with an invented scapegoat.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The opening follows a treatment denial assembled through several professional and administrative decisions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Each participant can explain a limited role while the affected person still needs a remedy.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: An appeal can therefore travel through the system without finding anyone authorized to repair the whole.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book uses this situation to distinguish local justification from responsibility for connected consequences.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its target is the architecture of the alibi, rather than a hidden master directing every hand.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The constructive argument asks for visible duties, usable appeals, independent review, and powers to interrupt.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It also challenges the comforting promise that every difficult system can be reduced to one enemy.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Mature simplicity preserves important distinctions while reducing unnecessary demands placed on affected people.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The full chapters connect that design problem to political anger and fantasies of total control.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Understanding complexity should create responsibility instead of becoming another reason nobody can be held answerable.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with The Victim No One Persecuted and trace how responsibility becomes dispersed.
